svg.text: Front, three-quarter right, three-quarter left, back. Dark display face with a stair of lit squares, dark red plating and chain-mail, a rail down the chest with four hatches, a squared backpack unit and looping cables.
Working labels, placeholder design, pending Legal review.
Body 99 units to the top of the head, head 18.8 units: about 5.3 heads tall
Build: heavy and blocky. Torso 1.36 wide, legs 0.95, arms 1.02 with 1.38 wide limbs,
Staging: three-quarter in play, mirrored when the fighter faces left. The front and
back are for modelling and are not staged in play.
The value rule: dark red plating, light gear and mail. Plating #3a161c, gear
#cfc7cb, mask #34313d, accent #d8705f. No black-and-red look: the plating is dark
red, the mask is a cool dark grey, the sigil is soft coral.
The mask is a dark display face. The sigil is a stair of four lit squares of growing
size on a diagonal: never a line grid, never a cross or plus, never a 2 by 2 block.
Hurt and brink drop a step.
Four hatches: head (a bar on the mask), chest (open, the chip shows there), back
(behind the backpack) and hip. The rail runs down the chest between them.
Front features (rail, chest and hip hatches, mail apron, shoulder cables) sit on the
front surface. Back features (backpack unit with four vents, back hatch, belt) sit
The mail is a tiled pattern in the shader (a normal-map look), not geometry. The
cables are two spring chains. Its flashes are steel for information and coral for
Read at play sizes: 80, 40, 24 and 12 px, in full colour and as a silhouette
Wear: fresh, bruised, battered, broken (three-quarter, upright)
The mask: neutral, taunt, hurt, rage, triumph (three-quarter), and the back of the head
Part list for the model (near LOD, about 1,980 triangles against the 2,500 budget)
A boxy head with a display face. A sigil decal slot (a stair of squares) and a head hatch bar.
Heavy plating over a dark under-suit.
A mail apron to the thigh with a zig hem. The mail is a tiled shader pattern.
A rail down the chest, chest and hip hatches on the front, a back hatch, the head hatch bar.
A squared unit with four vents and a back hatch.
Two looping cables from the pack over the shoulders to the rail and hip, on spring chains.
Heavy mail upper arm and plated forearm each.
Two plates, rigid on the shoulders.
Heavy dark boots with a light cuff.
Bones, about 26: root, pelvis, two spine, neck, head, backpack, four cable (two chains of
two, spring), two shoulders, upper arms, forearms, hands, thighs, shins, feet. Palette
masks: red channel plating, green gear, blue accent, alpha the emissive sigil (the squares).
